joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.admission: native FCFS, cap256 in every arm
fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: native in every arm; original completion boundary retained
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: Native STORE, LOAD, fences, streams, FIFO, references, completion and release paths all unchanged.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.observations: Same native recovery-order and native completion-finalize observation; add recovering-only read-only allocation integer snapshots. No extra CUDA query/sync, lookup, allocation or queue mutation.
fixed.arrival_sequence: same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals,EOS cap1024
fixed.B_LOAD_ORDER: native, no LOAD ordering adapter installed

selection: One native cell only, no conditional candidate or pressure expansion.
scope: Identify whether loaded GPU prefixes stay held while remaining tail allocation fails after LOAD acknowledgement. Same previously observed recovery workload, natural EOS, normal budgets. Not a policy contrast or end-to-end speedup claim. GPU UNRUN.

deployment.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
deployment.runtime: Retained original package and model cache; native model runner/mixin/worker/scheduler/KV manager hashes match; private torch CPU imports passed with CUDA uninitialized.
deployment.comparison_scope: All four arms rerun on this GPU; no historical latencies used as controls.

hypothesis_source: Pinned base scheduler makes async LOAD allocate num_new_tokens=0, retains prefix after successful completion, then allocates remaining computation tail. Existing trace shows ack then capacity failure but lacks held/free/tail integer counts.
stop_rule: One observation cell only. Preserve all outcomes. Use actual held/free/required fields to distinguish tail shortfall from whole-prefix reallocation; do not introduce a reservation, request priority, quantum or admission policy from this probe.
storage_note: Native data disk nearly full; this new session and its independent empty caches live on /tmp filesystem. Model/source remain original read-only locations. No past raw removed.
